item.title: AI must move beyond intelligence to offer wiser, ethical advice: Experts at IIT Ropar
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) must evolve beyond providing information to offering responsible, ethical and wiser advice, as growing dependence on the technology raises concerns over misleading responses, human decision-making and societal well-being, experts said.

item.title: Nothing OS 5.0 update based on Android 17, AI app builder, new Glyph features: Check rollout timeline, how to download
item.description: Nothing is expanding the stable rollout of Nothing OS 5.0, based on Android 17, to the Phone (4a) Pro, Phone (4a), Phone (3a) Pro and Phone (3a). The update adds interface and personalization changes, performance improvements and AI-powered tools. Availability is phased by device, region &amp; carrier.

item.title: Red Dead Redemption 2 players can claim free outfits, gold bars and Halloween rewards before November 4 deadline
item.description: Rockstar Games has introduced limited-time rewards and boosted payouts in Red Dead Online as part of its Halloween event. However, the offers do not include a free download of the full Red Dead Redemption 2 game.

item.title: Pebble Qore Vox brings AI meeting notes to your wrist: Check price, features and battery life
item.description: Pebble has launched the Qore Vox screenless wellness band in India at an introductory price of ₹5,799, combining health tracking with voice recording and AI-powered meeting summaries.

item.title: Redmi M100 Pro launched with Dimensity 7300-Ultra, 50MP camera and 5,500mAh battery: Check price
item.description: Xiaomi has launched the Redmi M100 Pro in China at CNY 2,499 (approximately ₹33,000), featuring the MediaTek Dimensity 7300-Ultra chipset and 12GB RAM. The smartphone sports a 6.67-inch 1.5K 120Hz OLED display, a 50-megapixel triple rear camera setup and a 5,500mAh battery with 45W wired charging.

item.title: Millennials lead AI shopping adoption in India at 84%, ahead of Gen Z: McKinsey
item.description: Millennials are leading the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) for shopping in India, with 84 per cent using AI-powered tools to search for products, compare options or make purchase decisions, ahead of 74 per cent of Gen Z consumers, according to a report by McKinsey & Company.

item.title: AI search gains 3-fold influence over traditional search in shopping decisions: McKinsey
item.description: Artificial intelligence-powered search tools are becoming a stronger influence on consumer buying decisions than traditional search engines, with nearly one-third of AI shoppers identifying them as the biggest factor behind their most recent purchase, according to a report by McKinsey.

item.description: From its early access launch to becoming one of the world's most recognised battle royale games, PUBG has transformed online gaming. With Netflix developing a live-action adaptation, the game's journey and global popularity are back in focus.

item.title: AU Small Finance Bank data breach: Hackers threaten to leak Aadhaar, PAN and customer records
item.description: AU Small Finance Bank is investigating a potential data leak involving its Salesforce platform after hackers claimed access to sensitive customer records. The allegedly exposed information includes Aadhaar, PAN, KYC documents, CIBIL scores, bank statements and loan records.

item.title: AI robotics may need 10 million hours of interaction data to reach production-level capabilities: Goldman Sachs
item.description: General-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) robotics could require an estimated 10 million hours of high-quality physical interaction data to reach production-level capabilities, highlighting the challenges in achieving commercial viability, even as technological progress in the sector is projected to be two to four times faster than the historical pace of autonomous driving technology, according to a report by Goldman Sachs.

item.title: India ranks second globally in AI-powered shopping, 76% consumers use AI tools: McKinsey
item.description: India is among the world's leading markets for AI-powered shopping, with 76 per cent of consumers using artificial intelligence tools to search for products, compare choices or make purchase decisions, according to a report by McKinsey, which highlighted the growing shift towards AI-led commerce.

item.title: Apple iPhone Air 2 specs leak: Dual 48MP cameras, 3,500mAh battery, 2nm A20 chip and more
item.description: Apple iPhone Air 2 is tipped to feature a 6.55-inch 120Hz OLED display, a 2nm A20-series chipset and dual 48MP rear cameras. The smartphone could pack a 3,500mAh battery, an 11% increase over the original iPhone Air.

item.title: Shubman Gill joins Temple wearable users: What Deepinder Goyal's ₹85,000 device can track
item.description: Shubman Gill tested Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal’s unreleased Temple AI fitness tracking device during India’s practice session in Auckland on 29 October. The forehead-mounted wearable is designed to track cerebral blood flow, nervous system responses and cognitive stress during physical activity.

item.title: Amazon Prime Video on track to generate tens of billions in revenue, Andy Jassy confirms
item.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says Prime Video is now profitable and on track to generate tens of billions of dollars in revenue. Amazon MGM Studios has earned over $1.2 billion at the global box office in 2026, led by hits such as ‘Project Hail Mary’.

item.description: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026 began on October 28, offering discounts on Apple iPhones, laptops, wearables and home appliances. The iPhone 17 is available at an effective price of ₹79,999, while the iPhone 15 is listed at ₹59,999 with eligible offers.

item.title: Karbonn Rebel 5G teased on Amazon: How the Indian brand eyes comeback with affordable smartphones for Gen Z
item.description: Karbonn is making a comeback in India’s smartphone market, targeting Gen Z and content creators with affordable devices amid rising smartphone prices. The homegrown brand has teased the Rebel 5G on Amazon, but its specifications, pricing and launch date remain unconfirmed.

item.title: AI-led services to generate up to USD 200 billion in new work by 2030: BCG report
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI)-led services are expected to generate between USD 100 billion and USD 200 billion in net new work by 2030, with technology services companies able to meet most of the demand by reskilling their existing employees, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG).
